responsibility: Implements the analyzer’s call_string representation for interprocedural context. This file manages the immutable tree of call-stack elements keyed by caller/callee supernodes, supports pushing calls, recursion-depth and function-occurrence queries, ordering and JSON/log dumping, and underpins the analyzer’s ability to distinguish contexts and return to the correct call site during exploded-graph exploration.
same_name_distinction: Defines the out-of-line behavior of the call_string API declared in call-string.h: stack extension, comparison, validation, printing/JSON dumping, recursion queries, and management of the persistent child tree used at runtime.
